notes.title: Sweet Surrender Revealed!
notes.content:
Dear friends,

We're excited to finally reveal our upcoming game!

Sweet Surrender, a Roguelite VR Shooter, will be coming out in late 2021. This is our biggest project yet: a fully-funded, action-loaded single player adventure set in a whole new world!

[h2]Wishlist here! [/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/638130/Sweet_Surrender/

To celebrate this reveal, we are running a sale on GrowRilla and Ellipsis!

Thanks for your support! As a small indie team, we really appreciate it!

notes.title: Update 10: New content
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/8CsDoCs.png[/img]

Hey everyone,

These past weeks have been very exciting for our team and we’d like to thank you for all your support.

[h1] Level Editor & Workshop support[/h1]
We’ve been very impressed by the levels some of you [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/514620/workshop/]have been creating[/url] over the past weeks and hope to see a lot more creations from the community. [b]Keep those levels coming![/b]

[list]
[*]Visual changes to the stars
[*]Various fixes to the level editor
[*]Various visual improvements
[*]Various other bug fixes
[/list]

Next week we’re heading to the US to showcase Ellipsis at two major events. 
[list]
[*]GDC (San Francisco) - at Intel booth on March 1st 
and at the Unity booth from March 1st - 3rd
[*][url=http://east.paxsite.com/peis]PAX East Indie Showcase[/url] (Boston): March 10th-12th
[/list]
We hope to see some of you there!

Thanks for your support,
[i]~ The team at Salmi Games[/i]

notes.title: Update 9: Ellipsis Is Available Now!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Ellipsis is finally available through Steam!
We've worked hard and fixed dozens of bugs reported by our beta testers over the past few months and are happy to release Ellipsis to Windows, Mac and Linux today. This wouldn't have been possible without you. Thank you for all your support!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/6iFXvYN.gif[/img]

[h1] Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added three additional worlds, including 75+ levels
[*]Improved controller support
[*]Fixed collision issues
[*]Fixed issue where triggers weren't activated 
[*]Fixed issue where Windowed mode isn't always centered
[*]Added option to delete levels in level editor
[*]Improved upload mechanism for the level editor
[*]Various fixes to the level editor
[*]Various other bug fixes 
[/list]
Thanks for your support,
[i]~ The team at Salmi Games[/i]

notes.title: Update 8: Release is just around the corner
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Ellipsis is going to be [b]released in 10 days[/b]. We're hard at work making the final fixes to the game and appreciate every feedback we can get. 

[h1] Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added support for 27 languages to the launcher
[*]Improved touch controls 
[*]New Levels! We replaced a few levels especially in the earlier section and added new levels, including ice levels in which you can slide around
[img]http://i.imgur.com/BIDOJ6Q.gif[/img]
This is a compilation of just 3 out of the many new levels we've added to the game! 

[*]Added controller support in windowed mode
[*]Added Steam controller support
[*]Fixed bug where you could not drag level items in the level editor, 
[*]Minimum aspect ratio has been set to 16:10. This allows us to create more interesting levels as we are not limited to the minimum aspect ratio of 4:3. If a lot of you use 4:3 monitors and are unhappy about this please contact us.
[*]Various graphics improvements
[*]Various Bugfixes and usability improvements
[/list]

[h1] Feedback [/h1]
Please continue to share your feedback and help us make Ellipsis an even better experience -- post [url=steamcommunity.com/app/514620/discussions/0/340412122409135040/]here on Steam forum discussion[/url] or send us an email at feedback@salmi.de.

That’s it for now!
Thanks for your support,
[i]~ The team at Salmi Games[/i]

notes.title: Update 7: Workshop Support
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’ve been working hard over the holidays on a new update. To kick off the new year with style, we’ve added [b]Steam workshop support[/b]. You can now [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=832028931]share all the levels[/url]
 you’ve created using the in-game level editor with the rest of the world. 

We’ve also made [b]a whole bunch[/b] of other improvements, check out the changelog below.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/gKbsJZ6.png[/img]

[h1] Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=832028931]Steam workshop support[/url], enabling sharing and downloading user created levels
[*]Steam cloud sync now working properly on Linux. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/514620/discussions/0/154645539345073896/]Please confirm![/url]
[*]Various visual improvements
[*]A multitude of bug fixes
[*]Finalized and activated Steam trading cards! Collect all five to earn the badge! 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/coRKTDZ.png[/img]
[*]Various sound improvements (We had an awesome jam day with our beautiful composer 
[url=https://twitter.com/EllipsisGame/status/811701572522704902]Filippo Beck Peccoz[/url]
[*]Various controller improvements and fixes, incl. easier navigation in the map
[*]Added speed modifier buttons for controller (R2, L2, RB, LB)
[/list]

[h1] Feedback [/h1]
This weeks update is focused on our level editor and the recently integrated Steam workshop support. Please continue to share your feedback and help us make Ellipsis an even better experience -- post [url=steamcommunity.com/app/514620/discussions/0/340412122409135040/]here on Steam forum discussion[/url] or send us an email at feedback@salmi.de.

We’re looking forward to seeing what you have created with the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=832028931]Ellipsis level editor![/url] Share your creations [u][b]before January 10th[/b][/u] and they might make it into the final game! 

That’s it for now!
Thanks for your support,
[i]~ The team at Salmi Games[/i]

notes.title: Update 6: Responding to your feedback
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We're only five weeks away from the launch of Ellipsis, meaning it's time to share some new content with you:

[h1] Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*]Introducing the 5th chapter, including 20 new levels and a new theme
Take a first look at some of the new levels:

[img]http://i.imgur.com/QElNrIA.gif[/img]

[*]Various improvements to the menu (based on user feedback)
[*]Improved mouse controls (Left button doesn’t toggle the player anymore, Right button to pause / leave)
[*]Various graphics improvements, including new high-end visuals
[*]Various bugfixes
[*]Added option to delete saves
[*]A launcher! Added different resolution and graphics options to the launcher

[img]http://i.imgur.com/YBasst7.png[/img]
[/list]
[h1] Pre-Beta testing[/h1]
Before pushing an update to you, our beta testers, we do some internal testing to make sure the new update doesn't have any negative impact on your play session. We'd like to invite some of our superfans to join our internal pre-beta testing process. This entails getting access to new content earlier and receiving updates on a more frequent basis. Sounds interesting? Just reply to this post and we’ll get in touch!

[h1] Feedback [/h1]
This weeks update is focused on the feedback you’ve sent us over the past month! Please continue to reach out with criticism and reception and help us make Ellipsis an even better experience. You can do so by either posting to our [url=steamcommunity.com/app/514620/discussions/0/340412122409135040/]Steam forum discussion[/url] or by sending us an email at feedback@salmi.de. Let’s keep the feedback coming!

Our next update will focus on improving the [url=https://twitter.com/EllipsisGame/status/798237050600357888]level editor[/url]. We'll have more to share within the next week. So get started on your levels!

That’s it for now!
Thanks for your support,
[i]~ The team at Salmi Games[/i]

notes.title: Update 5: Improving the Linux version
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Thank you for your continued support! Let's get straight to the point this week: 

[h1] Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added overworld menu (with multi-save slots and access to the editor)
[*]Added new enemies and new controls to the level editor
[*]Improved save system of the level editor
[*]Various other fixes to the level editor
[/list]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/AA0N420.gif[/img]
Want to access the level editor? This is how! 
[list]
[*]Improved Linux support (Sorry for breaking this with the last build)
[*]Particle effects improvements (e.g. small shrines, bounce enemies)
[*]Improved post-processing effects and other graphics improvements [*]Multi-saves support added 
[*]Added several achievements (Go get them!)
[*]Various other bug fixes
[/list]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/udWnxpY.gif[/img]
The level editor is shaping up well! Try it out, tell us what you think. We’d love to see your custom level creations!

[h1] Feedback [/h1]
Besides adding new features, we're working on eliminating bugs from the current build. Please continue to reach out here on the [url=steamcommunity.com/app/514620/discussions/0/340412122409135040/]Steam discussion forum[/url] or send us an email at feedback@salmi.de. Let’s keep the feedback coming!

That’s it for now!
Thanks for your support,
[i]~ The team at Salmi Games[/i]

notes.title: Update 3: Level Editor
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

The first week of testing has gone very well and we’ve received some great feedback. Thanks to everyone who has been posting helpful comments!

[h1] Level Editor[/h1]
Along with fixing a bunch of bugs, we are excited to introduce our in-game Level Editor. We’d love some feedback on it, so please try it out and share some screenshots/videos of your creations. We are hard at work on making level sharing super easy.

To see the editor in action, please check out this video:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JWQEgSZBjnk
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Lfih1F6.gif[/img]

[h1] Changelog[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Added the Level Editor
    [*]Added Linux support
    [*]Added a Volume and mouse sensitivity sliders
    [*]Fixed problem where level was automatically restarted after death
    [*]Fixed various mouse cursor issues
[/list]

This is how you access the volume & sensitivity slider as well as the level editor.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Lddw6IU.gif[/img]

[h1] Feedback [/h1]
As usually please let us know if you’re having any problems running Ellipsis - especially on lower end devices! Don’t hesitate to reach out here on the [url=steamcommunity.com/app/514620/discussions/0/340412122409135040/]Steam discussion forum[/url] or send us an email at feedback@salmi.de.

[h1] Joining The Beta [/h1]
If you‘re interested in joining our closed Beta, send an email to contact@salmi.de. We’ll make sure to add you to the next wave of Beta invitations we send out.

That’s it for now!
Thanks for your support,
[i]~ The team at Salmi Games[/i]

notes.title: Update 2: Beta released
notes.content:

The first batch of beta invitation emails have gone out, so please check your inbox. If you have received an email from us, you can use the Steam key to start playing the Beta right now! We’ll be sending out further invitations over the next few days.

[h1] Version 0.2[/h1]
The current Steam build doesn't contain all content that will be available at launch. Following you can find a list of what’s playable right now. The game itself is very self-explanatory, no instructions required.
[list]
    [*]Windows, Mac support. Linux support will be added [url=https://twitter.com/ysalmi/status/788829824685137920/]very soon![/url]
    [*]First 60 levels are playable (Out of 150+)
    [*]Improved mouse controls
    [*]Various bug fixes
[/list]

We are also hard at work on our In-Game Level Editor and we hope to share that with you in the next update.

The current Steam build doesn't contain all content that will be available at launch. Following you can find a list of what’s playable right now. The game itself is very self-explanatory, no instructions required.
[list]
    [*]Windows, Mac support. Linux support will be added [url=https://twitter.com/ysalmi/status/788829824685137920/]very soon![/url]
    [*]First 60 levels are playable (Out of 150+)
    [*]Improved mouse controls
    [*]Various bug fixes
[/list]

We are also hard at work on our In-Game Level Editor and we hope to share that with you in the next update.

[h1] Feedback [/h1]
As usually we look forward to your feedback. Please don’t hesitate to reach out here on the [url=steamcommunity.com/app/514620/discussions/0/340412122409135040/]Steam discussion forum[/url] or send us an email at feedback@salmi.de.

[h1] Joining The Beta [/h1]
If you‘re interested in joining our closed Beta, send an email to contact@salmi.de. We’ll make sure to add you to the next wave of Beta invitations we send out.


That’s it for now!
Thanks for your support,
[i]~ The team at Salmi Games[/i]

We’re doing waves of sign-ups so watch your inbox. 

[h1] Stay Tuned For More [/h1]
We’ll be posting updates to the Steam page frequently with developer updates, new builds and surprises. Please also follow us on [url=twitter.com/EllipsisGame/]Twitter[/url] and [url=facebook.com/PlayEllipsis//]Facebook[/url]. 


Thanks for your support,
